pr_title: [Transform] avoid transform failure during rolling upgrade
pr_body:
ensure shards are searchable after creation of a new internal index version

fixes #72525
pr_comments:
> On initial creation, we are guaranteed to have no replicas. So waiting for all shards there is great. But, is it possible that a user adds replicas later? This means that during a rolling upgrade, we will have to wait for replicas to get assigned in certain cases.

The user isn't supposed to add replicas by himself I think, because it is a system index. The index uses `auto_expand_replicas 0-1`.

The added `waitForActiveShards` is probably not necessary:
https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/5baabff6670a8ed49297488ca8cac8ec12a2078d/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/admin/indices/create/TransportCreateIndexAction.java#L111

Nevertheless I thought explicit is better than implicit.

Waiting for yellow vs. green: Yes, yellow seems enough, however does that really matter? Having green sounds reasonable to me, given that the problems we are talking about are during rolling upgrade where nodes come and go.

> Yes, yellow seems enough, however does that really matter? Having green sounds reasonable to me, given that the problems we are talking about are during rolling upgrade where nodes come and go.

Green does require replicas to be assigned. So, it's waiting for a longer period of time.

But since this is a system index, a user updating the number of replicas is an unsupported case. I think the change is fine as is, just wanted to make sure we thought of this.

issue_context.title: [Transform] transform fails during rolling upgrade with Failed to load transform configuration
issue_context.body:
**Affected versions:** 7.12
**Fixed in:** 7.12.2

Transforms don't need to be stopped during a rolling upgrade, but can continue to run. A transform that runs on a to upgrade node will be automatically relocated to another node.

This relocation can fail with _Failed to load transform configuration_ if at least 2 transforms run at the time of the upgrade on the same node.

**Mitigation:**

Check the status of your transforms after the upgrade using the UI or API. In case the transform failed with the above error, `force` stop and start the transform again using the UI or API:

https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/stop-transform.html
https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/start-transform.html

As an alternative you can suspend transforms during the rolling upgrade, however this is not necessary, there are no downsides in restarting them as explained.

**Fix:**

Transform node allocation needs to check that shards are allocated.

review_comments:
We really only care if the primary shards are active right? 

I don't think this index ever really sets up replicas, but requiring tasks to wait for replicas seems like an unnecessary burden.

I wonder if waiting for a `yellow` status here is enough.
I think having `ALL` here is fine as the index has our original settings, which doesn't include replicas (I think).
